uuid.description:
Unique identifier of the product.
If not provided by the manufacturer, the UUID can be derived as specified in [the UUID section](/uuid).

brand_specific_id.description: Unique identifier of the container within the brand

volumetric_capacity.description:
Maximum amount of material the container can hold.
The volumetric unit has been selected so that the property would work with both SLA and FFF.

empty_weight.description:
Weight of the empty container.
The aim is to be able to put the container on a scale, subtract this number and be able to estimate the amount of material inside.

slug.description: Identifier within the material database directory structure. Has to correspond with entity yaml the filename.

hole_diameter.description:
Diameter of the hole in the middle of the spool.
Determines the maximum diameter of the spool holder rod.

inner_diameter.description: Inner diameter of the spool = minimum radius the fiament is rolled

outer_diameter.description:
Outer diameter of the spool.
Determines what spool holders/dryboxes the spool can fit into.

width.description:
Width of the spool (= height of the cylinder)
Determines what spool holders/dryboxes the spool can fit into.
(Maximum) size of the container in one of the horizontal dimensions

length.description: (Maximum) size of the container in the other horizontal dimension

height.description: (Maximum) size of the container in the vertical dimension.
